sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.
sponsored.fis: The specific pro-rata amount of tax refund will be calculated by the Nassau County Assessor's Office.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a portion of the 2024-2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2025 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor.
sponsored.fis: The specific pro-rata amount of tax refund will be calculated by the Nassau County Assessor's Office

sponsored.t: Authorizes Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2026 assessment roll and all of the 2025-2026 school taxes.
sponsored.fis: The specific pro-rata amount of tax refund will be calculated by the Nassau County Assessor's Office

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties having a population of more than 1.38 million and less than 1.42 million, determined in accordance with the latest federal decennial census.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing Aileen Monahan to transfer certain service credit to the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Aileen Monahan to transfer certain service credit in the NYSLRS to the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain crisis responders using a green light
sponsored.sum: Authorizes crisis responders assisting veterans and first responders in mental health emergencies to display a green flashing light.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum compensation standards for the reimbursement of home health agencies and persons employed thereof
sponsored.sum: Establishes minimum compensation standards for the reimbursement of home health agencies and persons employed thereof; directs the commissioner of health, in consultation with the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to develop methodologies to determine such minimum compensation standard.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Long Island rail road commuter's council study technologies which would allow seamless communication between fire departments and the Long Island rail road
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Long Island rail road commuter's council to study technologies which would allow seamless communication between fire departments and the Long Island rail road to improve passenger safety and emergency response efficiency.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "dismantling student antisemitism act", or "DSA act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "dismantling student antisemitism act", or "DSA act"; requires mandatory sensitivity training that includes the topic of antisemitism; includes reporting requirements regarding antisemitism complaints and disciplinary processes.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Potential withholding of State aid to higher education accredited institutions that are found to be not in compliance of this Act. Potential costs to higher education accredited institutions to implement antisemitism awareness and prevention in administrative, faculty, staff, and student sensitivity training seminars.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the widow of Howard Mahler to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Robin Garfinkle, the widow of Howard Mahler, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

sponsored.t: Relates to coordination of policies and services of the traumatic brain injury program with the office for the prevention of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Directs the coordination of policies and services of the traumatic brain injury program with the office for the prevention of domestic violence; includes the executive director of the office for the prevention of domestic violence on the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council.

sponsored.t: Relates to threats or harm to animals as a means of coercion or coercive control
sponsored.sum: Provides that the use of threats or harm to animals shall be considered a means of coercion or coercive control.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rules of evidence and the admissibility of evidence alleged to be fabricated by generative artificial intelligence
sponsored.sum: Provides that in any civil, criminal or family court proceeding, where evidence is offered and a party contends that such evidence has been fabricated by means of generative artificial intelligence, the court shall not, on that ground alone, conduct an inquiry into such alleged fabrication unless the party so contending makes a showing sufficient to support a reasonable inference that the evidence may not be authentic.

sponsored.t: Changes the state's metrics for measuring greenhouse gas emissions
sponsored.sum: Changes the state's metrics for measuring greenhouse gas emissions from the current 20-year metric to a 100-year metric.

sponsored.t: Establishes the persistent domestic violence offender registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes the persistent domestic violence offender registry to provide information on the persistent domestic violence offender, including but not limited to, the name, date of birth, conviction date, county or counties of convictions, and a current photograph of any person who was convicted of an offense against a victim of domestic violence and has at least one prior conviction for a family offense committed against a member of the same family as defined in subdivision one of section 530.11 of the criminal procedure law; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to setting bail for defendants that pose a current physical threat to public safety
sponsored.sum: Requires the court to make an individualized determination whether a defendant poses a current physical threat to any person or to public safety when making a bail determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to a property tax exemption for a farm operation certified for the production of organic crops
sponsored.sum: Creates a real property tax exemption for land of a farm operation which is in the process of being certified for the production of organic crops.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the adoption of a dog or cat; establishes a $100 credit for a maximum of three dogs or cats per taxable year.

sponsored.t: Requires assent of two-thirds of the members for any bill that enacts or increases tax revenues
sponsored.sum: Requires assent of two-thirds of the members for any bill that enacts or increases tax revenues.

sponsored.t: Requires bills containing an unfunded mandate for a county or municipality to be referred to the state comptroller for opinion before being certified
sponsored.sum: Requires bills containing an unfunded mandate for a county or municipality to be referred to the state comptroller for opinion before being certified.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state school mental health services program coordinator
sponsored.sum: Establishes the school mental health services program coordinator to provide qualifying public and nonpublic schools with mental health services professionals.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing solar energy tax credits, implementing a solar STAR credit, and amends provisions relating to the siting of major renewable energy facilities
sponsored.sum: Increases solar energy tax credits; implements a solar STAR credit; amends provisions relating to the role of municipalities in siting of major renewable energy facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the theft of a package intentionally taken from the residence of another following delivery by the postal service or a commercial carrier
sponsored.sum: Makes the theft of a package intentionally taken from a porch, driveway, doorway or other area adjacent to the residence of another following delivery of the package to such residence by the postal service or a commercial carrier a felony.

sponsored.t: Includes exposing a first responder or correction officer to fentanyl, a fentanyl derivative or an opiate containing fentanyl or fentanyl derivative in the definition of the offense of assault in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes exposing a first responder or correction officer to fentanyl, a fentanyl derivative or an opiate containing fentanyl or a fentanyl derivative in the definition of the offense of assault in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal sale of a controlled substance to a person less than fourteen years of age
sponsored.sum: Provides that criminal sale of a controlled substance by an adult to a person less than fourteen years of age is a class A-II felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to immediate enforcement of securing orders through issuance of a bench warrant when a defendant fails to appear
sponsored.sum: Provides for the immediate enforcement of securing orders through issuance of a bench warrant when a defendant fails to appear for a scheduled appearance; removes 48 hour notice requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to consecutive sentencing for certain convictions for sex crimes
sponsored.sum: Provides for consecutive sentencing for certain convictions for sex crimes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a study of the traffic conditions in the incorporated village of Cedarhurst and its immediate boundaries, thoroughfares, county and state roads
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a study of the traffic conditions in the incorporated village of Cedarhurst and its immediate boundaries, thoroughfares, county and state roads.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to reimburse municipalities for loss of real property tax revenue resulting from establishment of community residential facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to reimburse municipalities for loss of real property tax revenue resulting from the establishment of community residential facilities for the disabled.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a job creation tax credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a job creation tax credit; provides that the amount of the credit shall be six percent of the total amount of wages paid to the qualified employee during the employee's first six months of employment and if the qualified employee was receiving unemployment insurance benefits at the time of hire for a minimum of thirteen weeks or is employed directly in the manufacturing process in an eligible industry, the amount of the credit shall be twelve percent of the total amount of wages paid to the qualified employee during the employee's first six months of employment; caps the credit at $750 for any qualified employee and $1500 for any qualified employee who was receiving…

sponsored.t: Provides for the review of unfunded mandates
sponsored.sum: Provides for the review of unfunded mandates; provides that the comptroller shall provide a fiscal note for unfunded mandates affecting political subdivisions; directs a continuing study.

sponsored.t: Requires sex offenders to verify their residence and registration on a biannual basis
sponsored.sum: Requires sex offenders to verify their residence and registration on a biannual basis; provides that the division shall mail a verification form to each registered sex offender on a different random date during each six month period of the calendar year.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for certain crimes involving tampering with a witness or intimidating a victim or witness
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for certain crimes involving tampering with a witness or intimidating a victim or witness; increases the penalty for tampering with a witness in the third degree and intimidating a victim or witness in the third degree to class D felonies; increases the penalty for tampering with a witness in the second degree and intimidating a victim or witness in the second degree to class C felonies.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing Bella's Law, which correlates animal abuse with domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Establishes Bella's Law which calls for an investigation into possible domestic violence or abuse for persons who have been accused of animal abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a hotline for the reporting of various forms of abuse which may jeopardize the health or welfare of any person
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a hotline for the reporting of various forms of abuse which may jeopardize the health or welfare of any person.

sponsored.t: Provides for mental home health care services for the aging
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of mental health and the director of the state office for the aging shall establish a mental home health services program for the aging to facilitate access to mental home health services to respond to identified mental health needs, including those needs that may have resulted from the COVID-19 pandemic, and for the aging or families that may not have access to mental health professionals in-person; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals; removes requirement that an animal be killed with aggravated cruelty in order to be guilty of such crime.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of special franchise property
sponsored.sum: Exempts water system property owned by a private water-works corporation located in counties with a population of one million or more that are special assessing units from being included as special franchise property.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education to develop model mental health screenings for students and associated guidelines to assist school mental health screeners to perform mental health screening services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education, in conjunction with the commissioner of health and the commissioner of mental health, to develop model mental health screenings for students and associated guidelines to assist school mental health screeners to perform mental health screening services to identify concerns in students' mental health.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain former full-time police officers to be eligible to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes former full-time police officers with the New York city police department to be eligible to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and contingent on their score, to be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer for the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Amends the 2024 capital projects budget to allow competitive grants to include funding for safety and security projects at small businesses at risk of hate crimes or attacks
sponsored.sum: Amends the 2024 capital projects budget to allow competitive grants to include funding for safety and security projects at small businesses at risk of hate crimes or attacks.
sponsored.fis: This legislation would invest an additional $65 million toward protect- ing New Yorkers and those visiting the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting state funding of any college if instructional staff advocates or engages in activities on campus in support of a terrorist organization
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state funding of any college if instructional staff promotes, encourages, advocates or engages in activities on campus in support of a terrorist organization as defined in federal statute.

sponsored.t: Enacts the energy assessment cap and consumer cost relief act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "energy assessment cap and consumer cost relief act" to limit certain surcharge increases; directs studies on costs associated with environmental and energy laws; directs a study on the value of assets and utility gas infrastructure discontinued as a result of laws and regulatory actions; institutes a moratorium on related surcharges, taxes, fees and cost bearing regulations for five years.
sponsored.fis: To be determined, and this legislation will provide greater transparency on potential costs associated with the CLCPA

sponsored.t: Relates to informational notices provided on utility bills
sponsored.sum: Requires the public service commission to determine the cost to ratepayers of rules and regulations issued to comply with the New York state climate leadership and community protection act.
sponsored.fis: It will provide greater transparency on potential costs to ratepayers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for licensed mental health professionals in jails and prisons
sponsored.sum: Establishes a loan forgiveness program for licensed mental health professionals in jails and prisons for the purpose of increasing the number of mental health professionals rendering mental health services in correctional institutions; provides for eligibility and priority; provides for awards in the amount of $2,000; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Designates fire marshals employed in the Long Island Rail Road Company Office of the Fire Marshals as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates fire marshals employed in the Long Island Rail Road Company Office of the Fire Marshals as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing transparency to residential utility and municipality ratepayers on the cost impact of the climate action council's scoping plan
sponsored.sum: Requires utility corporations and municipalities to ensure that bills for service to residential customers include a line item for cost impact measures taken in accordance with the climate action council's final scoping plan; requires the department of public service to establish a formula to enable utility corporations and municipalities to calculate the cost impact on each residential customer's bill attributed to measures taken in accordance with the climate action council's final scoping plan.
sponsored.fis: Provides transparency on fiscal impacts to ratepayers.

sponsored.t: Relates to physical therapists and occupational therapists in school districts and board of cooperative educational services
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts and board of cooperative educational services to pay physical therapists and occupational therapists in alignment with the department's career ladder pathway framework; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the spouses of certain volunteer firefighters to be issued a distinctive license plate for volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the spouses of certain volunteer firefighters to be issued a distinctive license plate for volunteer firefighters.

sponsored.t: Provides free hunting, fishing, and trapping licenses for residents who participated in the World Trade Center rescue and cleanup and who suffered a permanent disability
sponsored.sum: Provides free hunting, fishing, and trapping licenses for residents who participated in the World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup and who suffered a permanent disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for certain rules and regulations to be waived in order to promulgate collaboration between mental health providers to develop programs for the benefit of the mentally ill
sponsored.sum: Allows for certain rules and regulations to be waived in order to promulgate collaboration between mental health providers to develop programs for the benefit of the mentally ill.

sponsored.t: Makes an appropriation to the Island Park School District to offset a loss of tax revenue
sponsored.sum: Makes an appropriation of seven million dollars over seven years to the Island Park School District for the purpose of stabilizing the Island Park School District and offsetting a loss of tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Creates a New York state route 878, Nassau Expressway study
sponsored.sum: Creates a New York state route 878, Nassau Expressway study to evaluate the costs of completing the construction of state route 878 in Nassau and Queens counties; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to making a murder as the result of a drive by shooting murder in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Makes a murder as the result of a drive by shooting, murder in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effect of mandates on school districts
sponsored.sum: Provides that state mandates shall not be implemented in school districts after such district has passed a budget; provides that any such mandates shall be implemented in the following fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "save our small-business grant program" to aid certain small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "save our small-business grant program" to aid certain small businesses impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic.

sponsored.t: Relates to early intervention reimbursement rates
sponsored.sum: Provides that on and after April first, two thousand twenty-five, the department of health shall reimburse municipalities in an amount of sixty-six percent or more for the costs of early intervention services; directs the commissioner of health to review rates of reimbursement for early intervention services.

sponsored.t: Relates to withholding certain information during discovery where the defendant is associated with a criminal street gang or the offense is connected to a criminal street gang or criminal enterprise activity
sponsored.sum: Permits the court to withhold names, contact information, and statements of any victim or eyewitness from discovery where the defendant is associated with a criminal street gang or the offense is connected to a criminal street gang or criminal enterprise activity.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail eligibility for crimes committed by street gangs or a criminal enterprise
sponsored.sum: Authorizes crimes committed by members of street gangs or a criminal enterprise to be eligible for bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to the health care and mental hygiene worker bonuses
sponsored.sum: Includes any parent or parent of a minor who cares for such minor child with an intellectual or developmental disability within the health care and mental hygiene worker bonuses.

sponsored.t: Relates to the custody of defendants who are subject to electronic location monitoring
sponsored.sum: Provides that defendants who are subject to electronic location monitoring are not considered confined or in the custody of the sheriff

sponsored.t: Improves the transportation of children with special needs
sponsored.sum: Improves the transportation of children with special needs to and from school; provides that bussing time shall not exceed one and one-half hours; provides a special needs liaison to work with each family with a child with special needs; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to tampering with electronic monitoring equipment
sponsored.sum: Creates the crimes of tampering with electronic monitoring equipment in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Defines antisemitism for purposes of the education law
sponsored.sum: Defines antisemitism for purposes of certain reviews of practices by the department of education.

sponsored.t: Places kratom on the schedules of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Establishes kratom, otherwise known as mitragyna speciosa korth, as a schedule I controlled substance.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of Lido Beach
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of Lido Beach.

sponsored.t: Requires the payment of regular wages to bay constables employed by the town of Hempstead, Nassau county, who have sustained injuries or illnesses in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Requires the payment of regular wages to bay constables employed by the town of Hempstead, Nassau county, who have sustained injuries or illnesses in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of East Atlantic Beach
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to establish a speed limit of less than 30 miles per hour on certain highways in the community of East Atlantic Beach.

sponsored.t: Provides an extension for payment of real property taxes owed by a federal employee furloughed or designated non-pay due to a lapse in federal appropriations, or their spouse or domestic partner
sponsored.sum: Provides a temporary extension for payment of real property taxes owed by a person who has been a furloughed or designated non-pay federal employee due to a period of lapse in discretionary appropriations by the federal government, or by the spouse or domestic partner of such person; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the registration of electric personal mobility devices; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "responsible implementation of e-bike regulations for safe cycling (RIDERS) act; defines "electric skateboard" and "electric personal mobility device"; requires the registration of all electric personal mobility devices, including, but not limited to, bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters and electric skateboards; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: Additional revenues to the Department of Motor Vehicles from electric personal mobility device registration and licensure fees.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "behavioral health transportation access act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "behavioral health transportation access act", in relation to establishing a transportation assistance voucher demonstration program for certain outpatient mental health and substance use disorder services.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Costs will depend on program design, participation levels, and available state, federal, or private funding sources. The bill does not establish an entitlement

sponsored.t: Includes the Island Park Public Library as an eligible library for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority
sponsored.sum: Includes the Island Park Public Library as an eligible library for the financing of projects through the dormitory authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the village of Malverne to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Malverne to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to develop new parkland or capital improvements to existing parks within the village.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes for property acquired for park or recreational purposes by the town of Hempstead
sponsored.sum: Extends from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2027, the expiration of provisions of the town law relating to payments in lieu of taxes for property acquired for park or recreational purposes by the town of Hempstead.

sponsored.t: Extends a payment in lieu of taxes for Lido Beach in the town of Hempstead
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of payments in lieu of taxes for Lido Beach in the town of Hempstead until June 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the provisions of accepting payment in lieu of taxes for property acquired for parks or recreational purposes
sponsored.sum: Extends the provisions of accepting payment in lieu of taxes for property acquired for parks or recreational purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the residential parking permit system within the area known as Elmont in the town of Hempstead
sponsored.sum: Expands the residential parking permit system within the area known as Elmont in the town of Hempstead to include all of Sussex Road.
